discription: A warm and evolving saw wave pad sound with a long release, featuring a modulated low-pass filter.
code: { arg out=0, freq=440, amp=0.1, gate=1, rq=0.5, pan=0; var sig; var env = EnvGen.ar(Env.adsr(0.5, 2.0, 0.7, 5.0, curve: -4), gate: gate, doneAction: 2); var lfo = SinOsc.kr(0.2).range(0.1, 0.9); sig = Saw.ar(freq); sig = RLPF.ar(sig, freq * 4 + (lfo * freq * 2), rq); sig = sig * amp * env; Out.ar(out, Pan2.ar(sig, pan)); }
